description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting  Mnemonic Wall
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Mnemonic Wall
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Essence Flux to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
